from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u082/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    templates = []
    seed_cells = set()
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if row[c] == 0:
                c += 1
                continue
            start = c
            while c < w and row[c] != 0:
                c += 1
            if c - start > 1:
                seq = row[start:c]
                templates.append(seq)
                seed_cells.update((r, j) for j in range(start, c))
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            value = grid[r][c]
            if value == 0 or (r, c) in seed_cells:
                continue
            seq = next((s for s in templates if value in s), None)
            if seq is None:
                continue
            start = c - seq.index(value)
            for i, color in enumerate(seq):
                x = start + i
                if 0 <= x < w and out[r][x] == 0:
                    out[r][x] = color
    return out
'''
